# Simplify a workflow

Identify the primary task and map what people need to find, decide, and do. Look for duplicate
explanations, competing actions, redundant screens, and visual wrappers that obscure the
hierarchy. Preserve necessary options, error recovery, permissions, and accessibility. Keep
secondary options discoverable when moving them behind disclosure.

Walk the original task after simplification. Check that common and exceptional paths still work
and that the main action and feedback are easier to find. Explain any removed or relocated
functionality and where the remaining paths lead.
